lena: quick heads-up — in the Go sampleapp I saw logs where the request-id flips to a redacted value after an auth retry. tracing breaks and log correlation is impossible. anyone seen this? :thinking:

ryan_sdk: hm staging or prod? which SDK version?

lena: staging only so far, go-sampleapp v1.4.2. sequence: incoming request has X-Request-ID, token expired, auth middleware refreshes token and retries downstream call. first log line has req id, later ones are `REDACTED` for the id.

mira_sre: can you paste a trimmed log snippet?

lena: sure:
```
INFO auth: recv headers {"authorization":"Bearer abc...","x-request-id":"rid-9876"}
WARN auth: token expired, doing refresh
DEBUG http: retrying request headers {"authorization":"REDACTED"}
INFO proxy: handled /svc/data x-request-id=REDACTED
```

ryan_sdk: that shows two issues: 1) redaction seems to replace the entire header blob when it sees Authorization, not just the token; 2) propagation across the retry path isn't explicitly copying existing request-id into outgoing requests.

mira_sre: ordering check — is otel propagation middleware registered before logging/redaction hooks? if propagator runs after redaction it won't help logging.

lena: in Go app we do: otelhttp.NewHandler -> logging middleware -> auth middleware. the retry happens inside auth middleware when calling an internal client. looks like the client lib strips headers and our redactor then collapses headers into a single sanitized string.

ryan_sdk: short fixes: - make redactor preserve header map keys and only mask the Authorization value; - make internal HTTP client copy `x-request-id` from context into outgoing requests (retry aware). Also add an otel propagation test for the refresh flow.

lena: i'll open two PRs: 1) change redactor to key-by-key mask (tests included), 2) client wrapper that injects req id on retries + integration test asserting same req id across the path.

mira_sre: add a quick CI integration test that runs the oauth-refresh scenario and asserts logs and span attributes have identical request-id. Also include a runbook note for staging: `export ENABLE_REQID_PROPAGATION=true` to enable client wrapper until patch rolls out.

logbot: deploy: canary rollback executed for oauth-refresh-go at 2026-03-23T11:05:00Z :warning:

ryan_sdk: thanks @lena — ping @eng-runtime once PRs are ready so we can bake this into SDK templates. small extra ask: ensure logging level for auth debug messages is INFO -> DEBUG mismatch earlier caused noisy prod alerts. change docs to recommend DEBUG for token refresh internals.

lena: will include loglevel note in PR description. will post links when ready. :thumbsup:
